scope: ui.chat.voice.heard_label; ui.chat.voice.said_label; ui.chat.voice.spoken_part_note (new); ui.chat.composer.placeholder.voice (new); retired key ui.chat.voice.cut_note

method: Listed changed keys with git diff cd9d85f30d a9161f63eb on the zh-CN and en ui.chat.voice.json / ui.chat.composer.json; read the en context notes for each key; compared with shipped neighbours ui.chat.voice.you_label, idle_caption, cut_chip, phase_speaking, stream_lost, byok_speech_failed, ui.agents.skills.detail.preview_truncated (预览仅显示此文件的开头部分), and the sibling composer placeholders; checked placeholder sets and key parity of en vs zh-CN by script (both namespaces: identical key sets, one expected plural-arm difference, see checks.placeholders); scanned all values of both namespaces in en and zh-CN for Unicode Cf/Cc characters (zero); grepped all zh-CN catalogues and en context/keys for ui.chat.voice.cut_note (zero hits); hashed files on disk with sha256 over whole-file bytes, the method scripts/i18n/ledger-check.mjs sha256File uses (en = en/<ns>.json; context = en/<ns>.context.json; verified the method by reproducing the precedent ff20f86abb96 composer en and context hashes from commit 8ed6c2f23b88).

checks.placeholders: None of the four keys carries a placeholder in en or zh-CN. Whole-namespace: identical key sets; the only brace-set difference is the untouched ui.chat.composer.secret_confirm_chars, an ICU plural on {count} where zh-CN correctly keeps only the 'other' arm (CLDR zh), outside this PR's diff and not re-audited.
checks.colon_form: heard_label 你说： and said_label 已朗读： use the full-width colon U+FF1A directly after the last character, no space, as the style guide's full-width ：  rule requires (precedent in the locale: 档位：, 智能体：, 建议更改：). spoken_part_note uses the same full-width colon mid-string.
checks.register: 你-neutral, no 您, no particles, no 请 and no sentence-final 。 on label/note/placeholder values: matches the guide (placeholder inside an input takes no 请; short labels have no final 。).
checks.idiom: 你说：/已朗读： read as natural lead-ins before the transcript / spoken text; 朗读内容：仅开头部分 states only that the audio stopped early without implying text is missing (the en context note's requirement); 仅……开头部分 mirrors the shipped 预览仅显示此文件的开头部分. 说话，或在此输入 is terse and idiomatic for a placeholder.
checks.consistency: 已朗读 (said_label, unchanged stem) and 朗读内容 (note) share the 朗读 verb for 'spoken aloud', matching stream_lost and byok_speech_failed; 你说 pairs with you_label 你; 说话 matches phase_speaking 正在说话 / idle_caption 说点什么吧.
checks.glossary: No glossary term is involved (no session/agent/transcript noun in the four values).
checks.width: Longest value 朗读内容：仅开头部分 = 9 full-width glyphs = 18 cells, one line in the voice history row; 你说： 3 glyphs; 已朗读： 4; 说话，或在此输入 8 glyphs = 16 cells, well inside the composer placeholder and shorter than the neighbour placeholder.idle.
checks.retired_key: ui.chat.voice.cut_note is absent from zh-CN ui.chat.voice.json, from en, and from every other zh-CN catalogue; no leftover.
checks.bidi_and_invisible: none in any value of the two namespaces, en or zh-CN (zh-CN is LTR, so no isolation marks are expected)

observations.note: not a finding, no severity; optional taste only
observations.why: a bare 说话 is accepted terse house style for placeholders; 直接 would read slightly warmer but is not required.
